title: I’ve never written a line of code. 3 weeks with Claude Code later, I have an 8-player online party game
author: Brawliens
selftext:
I’m a gamer, not a programmer. 3 weeks ago I started building a chaotic party game for my friends entirely with Claude Code. Brawliens: aliens abduct you and 7 friends for a game show, 30+ minigames, 8-player online on Steam.

My workflow is simple: play with friends, write down what feels bad, give the notes to Claude, play again. Repeat about 1,300 times.

New minigames were the easy part. Online multiplayer and getting through Steam’s review were the hard part (at one point a whole herd of cows vanished in the release build 🐄).

Free demo on Steam in a few days, wishlist here: [https://store.steampowered.com/app/5430390](https://store.steampowered.com/app/5430390)

What’s the hardest thing you’ve hit building with AI?
